subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Sequestered
solution:
The correct answer is 'Secluded.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word '**Sequestered**' means **Isolated and hidden away**. 

 
 
• Example: *The retired film star **sequestered** herself from the world*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of other given options:-
 
 
• '**Secluded**' means **Far away from other people; very quiet**.
 
 
• Example: *The monks **secluded** themselves from the rest of society*.
 
 
 
• '**Polished**' means **Shiny as a result of being rubbed**.
 
 
• Example: *The food is served on **polished** tables with mats*.
 
 
 
• '**Frequented**' means **A place visited often or habitually**.
 
 
• Example: *The resort is **frequented** by the rich and famous*.
 
 
 
• '**Decorated**' means **To add something in order to make a thing more attractive to look at**.
 
 
• Example: *They **decorated** the wedding car with ribbons and flowers*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The synonyms of the word 'Sequestered' are "Secluded,** ****Concealed, Cloistered**".
 
• The antonyms of the word 'Sequestered' are "**Adjacent, Adjoining, Contiguous**".
